question: 42 numaralı mağazada fiyat anormalliği var mı?

args.query:
SELECT 
    t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS transaction_price,
    t.quantity,
    t.ts,
    ROUND(t.unit_price - p.unit_price, 4) AS price_diff,
    ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) / p.unit_price * 100, 2) AS pct_diff
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
ORDER BY ABS(t.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC

args.query:
SELECT 
    t1.id AS txn1_id,
    t2.id AS txn2_id,
    t1.product_id,
    t1.quantity,
    t1.unit_price,
    t1.ts AS ts1,
    t2.ts AS ts2,
    ROUND((JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS minutes_apart
FROM transactions t1
JOIN transactions t2 
    ON t1.store_id = 42
    AND t2.store_id = 42
    AND t1.id < t2.id
    AND t1.product_id = t2.product_id
    AND t1.quantity = t2.quantity
    AND t1.unit_price = t2.unit_price
    AND (JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60 <= 5
ORDER BY minutes_apart, t1.ts

    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS charged_price,
    ROUND(t.unit_price - p.unit_price, 4) AS price_difference,
    ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) / p.unit_price * 100, 2) AS pct_difference,

args.query:
SELECT s.id AS store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.city,
       t.id AS transaction_id, t.product_id, p.name AS product_name,
       p.category, p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
       t.unit_price AS transaction_price, t.quantity,
       ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price), 4) AS price_diff,
       ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity, 4) AS total_impact,
       t.ts
FROM transactions t
JOIN stores s ON t.store_id = s.id
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price <> p.unit_price
ORDER BY ABS(t.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC
